Tooltip_BQoL_PryDoor: Force the door with a crowbar. Success depends on your Strength.
Tooltip_BQoL_PryWindow: Force the window with a crowbar. A failed attempt may break the glass.
Tooltip_BQoL_PryReinforced: This door is reinforced. You need Strength %1 to attempt it.
Tooltip_BQoL_TourniquetArm: Ties off the wound with a belt. Cuts bleeding sharply but hurts.
Tooltip_BQoL_TourniquetLeg: Ties off the wound with a belt. Cuts bleeding sharply but hurts, and slows you down until removed.
Tooltip_BQoL_RemoveTourniquet: Unties the limb and gives the belt back. The wound will bleed again if it has not healed.
Tooltip_BQoL_RemoveTourniquetLegacy: Unties the limb. This one was tied before the belt was being tracked, so there is nothing to give back.
Tooltip_BQoL_TourniquetItem: The belt tied around this leg. Taking it off unties the limb: the wound bleeds again and the belt comes back.
